description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar's first ability triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
